g.text: Shape Editor - Native SVG Editor - Animation Studio
Canvas: rotate + scale + translate + fill + stroke
Colour blend and target palette when Colour active
Position X and Y sliders (-80..80) when Position active
Timeline: one effect per step, draggable start and end handles.
Step cards list: Apply / Duplicate / Delete
constraint: playhead constrained to timeline width
constraint: conditional sliders stacked with 6px gap
